title: Seismo-Tectonic Fluid-Strain, Survey-Propensity Debiased Multi-Physics, Throw-Polarized Hanging-Wall Mechanics, and Self-Consistent Fractional Dinkelbach Allocation

experiments.name: EXP-STFD-1_pure_zero_catalogue_97ch
experiments.description: Strict 4-fold LOQO 2-stage multi-family model trained on 100% of fold-visible faults with flank decontamination (far_pool >= 3.0 px) over all 97 domain-debiased pure-physics channels (0 catalogue features at inference); emitted at exact H33 budget B = 37,654 with uniform d_min = 2.8 px spacing.

experiments.name: EXP-STFD-2_stfd119_uniform_d28
experiments.description: Strict 4-fold LOQO 119-channel model combining quadrant-stratified inner hide-and-recover Stage-1 draws (R = 4, buffer_px = 3), multi-draw Stage-2 spatial line-integral + Sato tubularity stacking incorporating calibrated 97-ch pure-physics OOF posteriors (p_phys, q_phys), and observable visible-prevalence quadrant calibration; emitted at matched B = 37,654 with uniform d_min = 2.8 px spacing.

experiments.name: EXP-STFD-3_stfd_fractional_dinkelbach
experiments.description: Self-consistent fixed-point fractional Dinkelbach 300 m kernel allocator (lambda* = alpha * DTI* / (1 - alpha * DTI*)) on the EXP-STFD-2 posteriors coupled with a dedicated pure-physics off-catalogue discovery reserve (d_vis >= 9.0 px, min_sep = 2.4 px).
